qa_pair.question: Which resume belongs to a person based in Lisbon, Portugal who holds a certificate issued by HashiCorp? Answer with the resume title exactly as shown in the account.

Which file name does Enhancv suggest for the PDF download of the resume whose title contains "Architect"? Answer with the exact file name including the extension.
When the resumes are listed oldest first by their ID, what is the title of the eighth resume?
The person behind the most recently modified resume (latest updatedAt) - what is their full name as written in the resume header?
How many resumes list Spanish as a language with the level text "Native"? Answer with a number.
